AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 37 °C

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Livestock Products? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Livestock Products.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Livestock Products.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Livestock Products.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Livestock Products.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Crop Production Structures? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Crop Production Structures.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Crop Production Structures.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Production Structures.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Crop Production Structures.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water conservation? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water conservation.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Water conservation.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water conservation.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water conservation.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Inorganic fertilisers? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Inorganic fertilisers.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Inorganic fertilisers.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Inorganic fertilisers.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Inorganic fertilisers.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Agroforestry? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Agroforestry.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Agroforestry.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Agroforestry.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Agroforestry.

7. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. pascal (Pa)
   C. newton (N)
   D. joule (J)

8. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

9. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Aquaculture? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Aquaculture.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Aquaculture.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Aquaculture.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Aquaculture.

11. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Producers
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Tertiary consumers

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Rearing Selected Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Rearing Selected Animals.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Rearing Selected Animals.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Rearing Selected Animals.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Rearing Selected Animals.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Aquaculture and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Rearing Selected Animals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Livestock Products and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Powered Tools and Equipment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

====

1. B — 100 °C

2. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Livestock Products.

3. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Production Structures.

4. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water conservation.

5. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Inorganic fertilisers.

6. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Agroforestry.

7. C — newton (N)

8. B — A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

9. D — Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

10. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Aquaculture.

11. A — Producers

12. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Rearing Selected Animals.
